description: This file defines platform-specific memory mapping functions for Git, specifically implementing custom mmap and munmap functions with validation and error handling.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Allocates and maps memory, reading data from a file descriptor with validation of parameters.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Frees the memory mapped by git_mmap.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
